rawContent: I thank @ZerlinaMaxwell for making her point that murders of Black people by Whites are ignored by right-wing politicians and most of the press. There has never been a time in USA history from the lives of Blacks were equally valued. That's why these issues don't go away. #BLM

The one big advantage that decent people now have over previous generations is the availability of fast, direct, unfiltered communication. It is so much easier to rally people quickly around causes and to notify people of what is going on anywhere in the country. #BLM movement!
